title: plywood.yml
description: plywood's config. Each key wraps a chant setting; plywood sets chant's keys from it, so a ci. key is refused.
$comment: Generated from packages/plywood/src/config by schemaFiles in src/config/index.ts; edit the group modules, then run npm run schema.

stacks.description: Each stack as project/stack. plywood init finds them when the key is absent.

dir.description: The directory holding the stack's Pulumi.yaml.

paths.description: Paths whose change previews the stack, beside its directory.

gate.description: The stack's gate, in place of the top-level gate.

backend.description: The backend URL. A plunge+ URL (plunge+file://, plunge+s3://) picks the plunge engine.

actions.description: The stack's day-2 actions, each run by plywood action <stack> <name> under a second person's approval.

name.description: The action's name, unique in the stack.

urn.description: The URN of a command:local:Command or command:remote:Command resource in the stack, replaced to run the action.

description.description: What the action does, for people and agents.

waves.description: Lists of stacks, updated in order, the first wave the canary; or canary and after. One wave per environment when absent.

canary.description: The stacks that update first, in a wave of their own.

after.description: Each stack to the stacks it updates after, beside the order its StackReferences give.

engine.description: pulumi or plunge. Absent, a plunge+ backend picks plunge, else chant reads PULUMI_BACKEND_URL and Pulumi.yaml.

backend.description: The backend URL. A plunge+ URL (plunge+file://, plunge+s3://) picks the plunge engine.

when.description: merge, or pull-request for /plywood up before merge.

requires.description: What an open pull request needs before /plywood up updates it. All four when absent. Only with when: pull-request.

merge.description: auto merges the pull request once its update before merge applied. Only with when: pull-request.

merge_token_env.description: The variable holding the token the merge uses: a secret on GitHub and Forgejo, a protected variable on GitLab. Needed with merge: auto.

merge_method.description: merge, squash or rebase. The forge's default when absent.

when.description: preview, from the first preview, or up, from an update before merge or a /plywood lock comment.

grain.description: resource, one lock per resource, or stack, one lock per stack. Absent, resource on plunge and stack on stock Pulumi.

approval.description: ledger, sealed or pr-review. Default ledger, and pr-review when approval_rules are set, so the merged pull request's reviews prove the approvers the rules need.

preview.description: true (the default): plywood init sets approvals.preview in the waves spec, so a merged wave applies only the plans its pull request previewed, or exits 4. false leaves it out.

approval_rules.description: Approval rules, read at base: stack glob to { roles, count, proven, name }, or a label to a group with all or any of such rules, nested up to three deep. A list of rules covers every stack.

policy.description: Rego rules and CrossGuard policy packs in the preview job, feeding chant's gate. Read at base.

path.description: The directory of Rego rules, relative to the repository root. deny_* denies, hold_* waits for a person, warn_* is a note line.

rego.description: The directory of Rego rules, relative to the repository root. deny_* denies, hold_* waits for a person, warn_* is a note line.

engine.description: The result shape the rules' engine prints: conftest or opa. A hold needs opa.

namespace.description: The Rego package to read. conftest: every package; opa: main.

command.description: argv in place of the engine's own; {policy} is the rules' directory at base, {input} the change set.

source.description: A shared rule set from a git ref, fetched by the job at the ref the base names. packs are then paths inside it.

repo.description: The repository: https://, ssh:// or file:// URL, or git@<host>:<path>.

ref.description: A tag, a branch or a full commit.

path.description: The Rego directory inside the repository.

providers.description: The provider packages a stack may use, such as aws and random; component packages too. plywood init writes the allowlist as a Rego rule into policy.rego and as the CrossGuard pack policy/plywood-providers.

packs.description: CrossGuard packs the preview and the update run with --policy-pack. Mandatory violations deny; advisory ones are note lines.

oneOf.description: The pack's directory, relative to the repository root.

dir.description: The pack's directory, relative to the repository root.

command.description: The estimator: a command line, or a list of arguments. It names {planJson}, the stack's preview JSON, and prints the stack's monthly cost on standard output. {target} is the stack.

format.description: What the estimator prints: chant, { monthlyDelta, monthlyTotal?, pastMonthlyTotal?, currency? }, or infracost's JSON.

currency.description: The currency the amounts are in, as a three-letter code. Absent, the estimate's own, else USD.

approve_above.description: The monthly change above which a preview needs an approval of its own and a wave waits for one. A stack the estimator could not price counts as over. Absent, the estimate is shown and holds nothing.

identity.description: The preview and up identities per cloud, for every stack and per stack glob. The preview job trades its OIDC token before the program is checked out.

pulumi.description: A Pulumi Cloud token: team:<name>, user:<login>, organization or organization:admin.

preview.description: The preview job's identity per cloud, for every stack.

pulumi.description: A Pulumi Cloud token: team:<name>, user:<login>, organization or organization:admin.

up.description: The update job's identity per cloud, for every stack.

stacks.description: Stack glob (project/stack; * stays within one segment) to its own preview and up identities. The first glob that matches a stack is its.

pulumi.description: A Pulumi Cloud token: team:<name>, user:<login>, organization or organization:admin.
A Pulumi Cloud token: team:<name>, user:<login>, organization or organization:admin.

environments.description: Environment globs the rule covers. Absent: every environment.

pulumi_cloud.description: The Pulumi Cloud organization the stacks' state is in. With identity's pulumi tokens, each job trades for its own access token.

api_url.description: The Pulumi Cloud API, for a self-hosted one. Default https://api.pulumi.com.

audience.description: The OIDC token's audience. Default urn:pulumi:org:<org>.

review_stacks.description: A stack per open pull request. Off when absent.

template.description: The stack whose config a review stack starts from, as project/stack.

name.description: The review stack's name: pr-{number}, or pr-{number}-<suffix>. Only stacks named so are destroyed.

ttl.description: How long a review stack lives after its last update, such as 72h. chant's default when absent.

ephemeral.description: A stack per open pull request. Off when absent.

template.description: The stack whose config a review stack starts from, as project/stack.

name.description: The review stack's name: pr-{number}, or pr-{number}-<suffix>. Only stacks named so are destroyed.

ttl.description: How long a review stack lives after its last update, such as 72h. chant's default when absent.

notify.description: Chat and webhook messages when a wave waits, an update is refused or fails, or drift is found. Each value names a variable.

oneOf.description: The variable holding the incoming webhook's URL.

webhook.description: The variable holding the incoming webhook's URL.

oneOf.description: The variable holding the incoming webhook's URL.

webhook.description: The variable holding the incoming webhook's URL.
A generic webhook; each chant.notify/v1 event is signed with webhook_key. The variable holding the webhook's URL, or { url, key }.

url.description: The variable holding the webhook's URL.

key.description: The variable holding the signing key.

webhook_key.description: The variable holding the key the webhook's events are signed with.

events.description: The events to send: waiting, refused, failed, drift. Default: all of them.

relay_key.description: The variable holding the relay key.

on.description: The events to send. Default: all of them.

relay.description: The variable holding the relay key. A waiting wave's Slack and Teams messages then carry the approval that plywood notify relay records.

telemetry.description: One OpenTelemetry trace per run over OTLP/HTTP, with a span per stack. OTEL_* variables in the job win over these.

endpoint.description: The OTLP/HTTP base URL; /v1/traces is added.

headers_secret.description: The variable holding the OTLP headers, k=v,k2=v2.

headers_env.description: The variable holding the OTLP headers, k=v,k2=v2.

reports.description: The reports bucket: where each run's HTML report is kept and where plywood estate writes the estate, the delivery metrics and the audit record.

url.description: The same as bucket, under the spelling plywood.yml used before.

drift.description: The scheduled drift check. Off when absent.

schedule.description: A five-field cron line, such as "0 6 * * *"; the drift job runs on it.

stacks.description: The stacks the job reads, by name or project/* glob. Every stack when absent.

audit_log.description: aws or aws:<region>, or a stack glob to one: the CloudTrail plywood drift reads to name who changed each drifted attribute.

respond.description: What plywood does about a finding.

drift.description: issue: one issue per drifted stack; pull-request: the issue and the drift agent's pull request; up: the issue and a gated update; none: the exit code only.

wave-refused.description: diff: a refused wave posts the diff against the approved preview; summary: the diff with a model's summary above it, the model set under agent.wave-refused; off: nothing.

apply-failed.description: triage: a failed update posts the stacks and resources that failed, with the error; off: nothing.

wave_refused.description: diff: a refused wave posts the diff against the approved preview; summary: the diff with a model's summary above it, the model set under agent.wave-refused; off: nothing.

apply_failed.description: triage: a failed update posts the stacks and resources that failed, with the error; off: nothing.

description.description: check: flag a pull request whose description leaves out what its preview deletes or replaces. Needs decide.

decide.description: The decide service respond.description: check asks.

backend.description: A decide.backends entry of chant.config, read at the target branch.

review.description: A model reviews each pull request and posts one note. It approves and gates nothing. Off when absent.

instructions.description: The instructions file, read from the base branch. Default .chant/review.md.

command.description: The model command: the prompt on stdin, the answer on stdout.

key_secret.description: The variable holding the model's key, the one secret the command sees.

key_env.description: The variable holding the model's key, the one secret the command sees.

agent.description: Agents that act on a request: /plywood agent <ask>, the drift agent's pull request, and the agents a production alert, a failed update on merge, a failed verify or soak, or a schedule starts. Each opens a pull request; none applies, approves or merges. All are off until set.

comment.description: Answer /plywood agent <ask> on a pull request.

drift.description: Open a pull request that fixes a drifted stack (respond.drift: pull-request).

alert.description: An agent opens a pull request for a production alert the relay recorded. true, or a map. The relay takes the alert at POST /alert/<source>.

window.description: Minutes in which one member's facts join one agent run.

relay_key_secret.description: The secret holding the relay key the facts are signed and checked with. Default CHANT_RELAY_KEY.

apply-failed.description: An agent opens a pull request for an update that failed on merge, beside the triage comment. true, or a map. Wave jobs record the failure.

window.description: Minutes in which one member's facts join one agent run.

relay_key_secret.description: The secret holding the relay key the facts are signed and checked with. Default CHANT_RELAY_KEY.

schedule.description: An agent does a recurring task on a cron and opens a pull request when the task changes something.

cron.description: When the agent runs: a five-field cron.

task.description: What the agent does on each run, in your words.

window.description: Minutes in which one member's facts join one agent run.

verify-failed.description: An agent opens a pull request when a stage's verify or soak check fails after an update. true, or a map. The promote and wave jobs record the failure.

window.description: Minutes in which one member's facts join one agent run.

relay_key_secret.description: The secret holding the relay key the facts are signed and checked with. Default CHANT_RELAY_KEY.

command.description: The model command: the prompt on stdin, the answer on stdout.

key_secret.description: The variable holding the model's key, the one secret the command sees.

key_env.description: The variable holding the model's key, the one secret the command sees.

max_runs.description: The most agent runs per day.

wave-refused.description: The model run behind respond.wave_refused: summary. Each key is optional; chant's defaults fill the rest.

command.description: The model command: the prompt on stdin, the summary on stdout.

key_secret.description: The secret (GitHub, Forgejo) or CI/CD variable (GitLab) holding the model's key.

max_cost_usd.description: The most US dollars the summaries may cost per day.

token_env.description: The secret (GitHub, Forgejo) or protected variable (GitLab) holding the token the push job pushes the agent's branch with. Default: the job token on GitHub and Forgejo, CHANT_FORGE_TOKEN on GitLab. A GitHub push with the job token starts no workflow, so the agent's commit gets no preview.

branches.description: Branch name to stack globs. A stack a glob matches updates from that branch alone.

labels.description: Pull request label to stack globs. A labelled pull request previews only the stacks its labels match.

forge.description: The forge the jobs talk to: github, gitlab or forgejo. Read from the repository's remote when absent.

url.description: The forge's base URL, for a self-hosted forge.

forge_url.description: The forge's base URL, for a self-hosted forge.

pulumi.description: The Pulumi CLI release the jobs run, such as 3.272.0: one for every stack, or a map of stack glob to release. plywood's image's release when absent.

plunge.description: The plunge release the jobs run, such as 0.2.0: one for every stack, or a map of stack glob to release. plywood's image's release when absent.

image.description: The image every job runs in, in place of plywood's: a reference pinned by digest, or a map with name and the plugins a prepared image carries.

name.description: The image reference, built FROM plywood-pulumi or plywood-plunge, pinned by digest.

plugins.description: Plugins the prepared image installs, as name@version or kind:name@version.

image_base.description: Which of plywood's published image sets the jobs run in: debian (Node 22 on Debian, root) or chainguard (Chainguard's images, Node 26, user 65532). With image, the set your own image was built FROM, which picks the install lines a job runs.

runners.description: The runner every job runs on: a label, a list of labels, or a GitHub runner group; or default, preview, up and drift each mapped to one. runs-on on GitHub and Forgejo, tags on GitLab.

runner.description: The runner every job runs on: a label, a list of labels, or a GitHub runner group; or default, preview, up and drift each mapped to one. runs-on on GitHub and Forgejo, tags on GitLab.

env.description: Variables every job runs with: the waves, the drift jobs and the pull request jobs. Values are written into the workflow, so put a secret under pass.

pass.description: Secrets the jobs read as variables, named and never written: a list of secret names, each passed under its own name, or a map of variable to secret.

parallelism.description: The most stacks a pull request previews at once in a wave, and the most a wave updates at once. Default: every stack of a wave at once in a preview, one at a time in an update.

forge_environments.description: Stack glob to the forge deployment environment its update jobs run in (GitHub and GitLab): a name, or a map with name and url. The first glob that matches a stack wins; stacks of one wave in different environments run in one job each.

environments.description: Each environment of promotion to its stage keys: targets (each project to the stack it updates there), its gate, hold, freeze, soak, risk and the rest. An entry that is a name, or a map with name and url, is read as forge_environments, its earlier spelling.

targets.description: Each project to the stack it updates in this environment, as stack or project/stack.

gate.description: When the stage's waves wait for an approval, in place of gate.

approval.description: Which approvals of the stage count, in place of approval.

approval_rules.description: The stage's approval rules, in place of approval_rules.

forge_environment.description: The forge deployment environment of the stage's jobs: a name, or a map with name and url.

hold.description: A manual hold: no release is promoted into the stage. true, or a map with reason, until (an ISO 8601 time) and description.

freeze.description: Freeze windows in which no release is promoted into the stage.

urgent.description: The role whose one proven approval passes the stage's gate on plywood promote --urgent.

pause_after_rollback.description: A rollback of the stage pauses it until plywood resume <env>.

on_verify_fail.description: A failed verify or soak check holds the stage as applied, or requests the rollback to its previous release, which waits for an approval.

failure_tolerance.description: The failed runs a wave lets through: a whole number, or a share such as 10%.

after.description: The stages a release applies in before this one opens for it. Default the stage before it in promotion.

queue.description: replace: the stage takes one release at a time, and a newer release waiting replaces an older one.

soak.description: Checks that must keep passing for duration after the stage's last update before a release is promoted into the next stage.

duration.description: A duration such as 30m or 2h, or 0 to wait for the checks alone.

items.description: One soak check: its kind, with that kind's settings beside it, and on_fail.
One soak check: its kind, with that kind's settings beside it, and on_fail.

risk.description: Over this risk score, the stage's waves and a promote into it take approval_rules on top of the gate's own.

approval_rules.description: Approval rules, as approval_rules takes them.

replan_dependents.description: Stacks whose dependents are previewed again when an output they read changes after an update in this stage.

publish.description: Release artifacts the stage publishes once it updated: { member, output }, or { secret }.

reads.description: Artifacts of an earlier stage the stage's update gets in a variable: { stage, artifact }.

agent_steps.description: Agent steps: a model's reading of the release the stage takes, with an answer of a declared shape. A step approves nothing and applies nothing.

config.description: Plain values the stage's jobs get as variables.

secrets.description: Secrets the stage's jobs get as variables, each named by where it is kept: a forge secret's name, or a map naming a cloud secret store.

imports.description: The config_sets this set takes first, in order.

promotion.description: The order a release moves through the environments, first to last. The merge updates the first environment's stacks, and plywood promote carries a release to each next one behind its gate. Each project takes one stack per environment: the one named after it, or the one environments.<name>.targets names. Off when absent.

risk.description: The change risk each preview scores from 0 to 1. Over approve_above, the change needs an approval of its own digest. Off when absent.

approve_above.description: The score above which a change needs an approval of its own.

questions.description: Questions the review agent answers from 0 to 1, each a reason in the score.

replan_dependents.description: Stacks (names or globs) whose dependents are previewed again when an output they read changes after an update. The preview waits at its own gate. Off when absent.

release.description: The release the merge cuts once the first environment of promotion updated.

cut.description: Cut a release once the first stage updated. On when plywood writes a pipeline.

label.description: The release's label, or auto for the next version.

recheck.description: How often a promotion a soak holds is tried again.

config_sets.description: Shared sets of config and secrets that environments import.

config.description: Plain values the stage's jobs get as variables.

secrets.description: Secrets the stage's jobs get as variables, each named by where it is kept: a forge secret's name, or a map naming a cloud secret store.

imports.description: The config_sets this set takes first, in order.

control.description: The control repo this repository tells after each update on merge: its project key or URL, or a mapping.

repo.description: The control repo, as host/owner/name or its https URL.

op.description: The Op the control repo runs on this repository's dependents. Default pulumi-up.

member.description: This repository's name in the control repo's workspace. Default the repository's name.

forge.description: The control repo's forge, when its host does not say.

token_secret.description: The secret holding the dispatch token. Default CHANT_CONTROL_TOKEN.

read_token_secret.description: The secret holding a read-only token for the control repo. Default CHANT_CONTROL_READ_TOKEN.

ref.description: The branch a GitLab or Forgejo dispatch runs on. Default main.

api_base.description: The forge's REST base, when the host's usual one is not it.

release.description: The plywood-applied dispatch carries the release digest of the updated commit, so the control repo reads that release's artifacts.

evidence.description: The runner identity the generated pipelines sign check evidence with: identity oidc, or runner_key_secret. Absent: nothing is signed.

identity.description: oidc: sign keyless from each job's OIDC token, as .chant/trust.json lists the workflow under keyless.identities.

audience.description: With identity: the OIDC token's audience. Default chant's, sigstore.

runner_key_secret.description: The secret (GitHub, Forgejo) or CI/CD variable (GitLab) holding the runner key, whose public half .chant/trust.json lists under runners.

local.description: true: plywood init names the check hooks under local.checks in .chant/trust.json, so a hook proven on a person's machine is skipped in CI.

roles.description: Roles from .chant/trust.json, any of which counts.

role.description: One role; the older spelling of roles.

proven.description: Only approvers a seal or a review proves count toward count.

name.description: The rule's name in its progress line, the preview note and the pending fact.

all.description: Met when every rule in it is met.

any.description: Met when one rule in it is met.
